name: Delivery_Settings_History
label: Delivery Settings History
_about: Every change of a Delivery setting or of the team roster: old value, new value, who, when (spec 05/08 Control Panel, CP-R5). Written by the server only (server/modules/delivery-management/settings.mjs).

fields.name: Setting_Key
fields.label: Setting Key
fields.helpText: A key from settings-defs.mjs, or roster:installer / roster:driver / roster:vehicle for the team roster.

fields.name: Effect
fields.label: Effect
fields.helpText: What the change did right away, if anything was recalculated.
